items.rule: A spell with Resonance>=1 evolves immediately when the token is spent. If no instance has Resonance>=1, the token instead grants +1 Resonance to one owned unevolved instance; no evolution this time. One use only, persists across saves; cannot exceed milestone.

Offer a seeded nonowned relic (rarity distribution common 60%, uncommon 35%, rare 5% among present rarities, re-normalize unavailable tiers) or evolution token. With 5 equipped relics the player may replace exactly one; replaced item is removed, not resold for chips. If no nonowned relic remains, give token option. No free Lifechips.

next betting decision means the player must be able to act on a later voluntary decision in the same hand; contested showdown has >=2 non-folded hands; fold facing wager >= current BB is sampled atomically on the fold.
Creditor Favor belongs only to the creditor, +1 each unique service completion, +1 after fully paid debt; never to the player by default.
Coal Table qualifies as contract for duties involving completion/top-two; debt repayments use table profit and 30% positive-net rule.

NPC debts remain live after leaving a table; at most once per completed act an NPC with obligation and >=2 liquid chips may voluntarily repay from own wallet: min(debt_due, floor(0.15*max(0,wallet-1))). This is an extra optional payment, not fabricated winnings; ordinary 30% positive-net repayment still applies to qualifying simulated future tables. No obligation disappears on absence; can become overdue after four actual completed qualifying tables.

Bailiff Sable replaces one Briar Lock copy with one Quiet Briars evolution (remaining Spellbook eight cards). Cost/window unchanged per P4 evolution. Public tells and Aether limits intact. This change requires balance retest.

1 eligible opponent: automatically that one; exactly 2: automatically both; 3+ eligible: caster chooses up to two different targets, AI picks using only legal information. No eligible target means illegal cast. Do not reveal folded or already exposed hands.
